engine_repo.description: org/repo hosting the engine's own issue tracker (intake, pinned comments, escalations) -- distinct from the work repos in repos.yml

initial_task.description: Task id enqueued (with the root run's resolved repo) for a newly accepted ticket

intake.description: Eligibility filter applied before the first state/artifact write

public.description: Whether tickets/artifacts may be published (dashboard, public-safe gate)

public_safe_label.description: Label a ticket must carry before intake accepts it when public is true
